submitted.rationale: All three EQE readings were essentially zero and within noise: idx12 -0.0063%, idx24 -0.0015%, idx28 -0.0045%. That fits what we'd expect for La–Sb oxides, which are wide-gap (≳3 eV) antimonates/oxides and shouldn't absorb 2.1 eV photons. The XRD scans of idx 4, 12 and 21 were dominated by what looks like substrate peaks (Q≈4.55, 5.33) plus weak, poorly defined film peaks. None showed a clear small-gap phase. Idx24 had the highest measured value, though it is not meaningfully different from the others.

rejected.reason: EQE -0.0063%. This is near the La3SbO7/La3O3Sb composition and gave no photoresponse at 2.1 eV.
EQE -0.0045%. The Sb-rich end did not improve on idx24.
